acquisition_method.evidence: we used targeted mass spectrometry to quantify 60 peroxisome proteins through the HCMV infection cycle.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Whole cells and organelle-enriched fractions derived from differential centrifugation or density gradient ultracentrifugation were lysed in lysis buffer (4% SDS, 0.1M NaCl, 50mM TrisHCl, 0.5mM EDTA, pH8.0) and reduced/alkylated using 25mM TCEP solution (Thermo Fisher #77720) and 50mM 2-chloroacetamide (MP Biomedicals #ICN15495580) at 70°C for 20 min.

cleavage_agent.evidence: s were recovered by methanol-chloroform precipitation, and resuspended in 25mM HEPES (pH8.2) with MS-grade Pierce trypsin (Thermo Fisher #90057) at a 1:50 trypsin:protein weight ratio for 16hrs at 37°C.

collision_energy.evidence: Isolation window set to 1.2 m/z, normalized collision energy (NCE) to 28, and target values of 3E5 and 1E5 for full-scan MS and MS2, respectively.
